BiblicalUsage: gêlel is the word for dung, ball of dung. I meet it 4 times across the Bible, and Job is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe gêlel matters because God speaks plainly, and plain words carry real weight. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
RelatedEvents: Ezekiel's Siege Signs; Ezekiel's Rationed Bread
